notes: Corrected three construct chains whose rectum carries an article the ASV renders anarthrously: יֶתֶר הַגִּלְעָד → *the rest of Gilead*, חֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה → *the half tribe of Manasseh*, and חֶבֶל הָאַרְגֹּב → *the region of Argob*. In each the accepted alignment supplied the *the* on the construct noun and marked the article unrepresented; rule 29 gives the single written *the* to the present article morpheme and leaves the construct bare, and rule 29's proper-name paragraph says a toponym's segmented article is no exception.
מַמְלֶכֶת עוֹג → *the kingdom of Og* and אֶרֶץ רְפָאִים → *the land of Rephaim* are unchanged: no article morpheme stands in either, so the *the* on the construct is a genuine supply.
*even* stays on the לְ of לְכָל־הַבָּשָׁן, the one morpheme in the phrase the word can answer to; the ASV margin reads *with* for the same preposition.
